findings.description: useAiJobApplicationSummary called with || 0 fallback, fabricating a non-nil ID when no succeeded summary exists.
findings.detail: Line 41: `aiJobApplicationSummaryId: (status === "succeeded" && aiSummary?.id) || 0`. When status is not 'succeeded' or no summary exists, the expression `(status === "succeeded" && aiSummary?.id)` evaluates to false/null/undefined, and `|| 0` substitutes 0. This fires a GET request to `/ai_job_application_summaries/0` on every render when no succeeded summary exists, producing a guaranteed 404. The spec states the full structured data should be fetched 'only when a summary exists and status is succeeded'. The correct fix is conditional invocation -- e.g., pass `undefined` or use a disabled flag so the query does not fire at all when the guard fails. Known Failure Pattern #13 in the pipeline CLAUDE.md explicitly prohibits || 0 fallbacks and cites this exact symptom as the motivating failure.
